mentions.name: AI-powered language-learning app
mentions.description: This app is an AI-powered language-learning tool where users upload images of random texts, and the AI provides grammar and vocabulary hints so the user can attempt the translation on their own — like Google Lens but without the final translation. The hardest technical challenge was locating the exact position of the text within the input image.
